summary.en: Replaced Sèvres. Fixed the Greek-Turkish frontier on the Evros, returned Eastern Thrace, Imbros and Tenedos to Turkey, and gave the Dodecanese to Italy. The convention on the exchange of populations was signed alongside it in January.

sources.title: Twice a Stranger: The Mass Expulsions that Forged Modern Greece and Turkey
sources.author: Bruce Clark

title.en: The Treaty of Lausanne and the Exchange of Populations
